request:
I run a small tailoring shop in Kumasi and I want to keep my orders in order. I need to save each customer with their name, phone number and their measurements: chest, waist, hip and length, all in inches. For a customer I take orders, and each order has the garment, the date it is due, the price and the deposit the customer has paid, in cedis. The deposit can never be more than the price. I want to see all the orders for one customer and look at a single order. I also want to see every order that is due on or before a date I choose, so I know what to finish first. When a customer picks up their clothes I mark the order as collected, and collected orders should no longer show in that due list.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: Should each customer have one set of measurements that you update when they change, or should each order keep its own measurements from the time it was taken?
A: No, measurements are kept on the customer.
Q: Can a customer pay more after the deposit (for example, the balance at pickup), and should an order be allowed to be marked collected if it is not fully paid?
A: No preference: you decide.
Q: Can two customers share the same phone number, or should each phone number belong to only one customer?
A: No preference: you decide.

Where the client has no preference or did not answer, choose the simplest option and add nothing they did not ask for (no logins, PINs or extra required fields).
summary:
I've written `app.py`. It saves your customers and orders in a file called `tailoring.db` in the same folder. I started it and tried the main steps. Saving a customer and an order worked. A deposit bigger than the price was refused. A collected order dropped off the due list.

**Endpoints**
- `POST /customers`: adds a customer with name, phone, and chest, waist, hip and length in inches. You get back the customer's ID.
- `GET /customers/{id}`: shows one customer.
- `PUT /customers/{id}`: updates a customer's details. I added this because measurements are kept on the customer, so you need a way to change them.
- `POST /customers/{id}/orders`: adds an order with garment, due date (YYYY-MM-DD), price and deposit in cedis. It's refused if the deposit is more than the price.
- `GET /customers/{id}/orders`: lists all of one customer's orders, earliest due date first.
- `GET /orders/{id}`: shows a single order.
- `GET /orders/due?on_or_before=YYYY-MM-DD`: lists orders due on or before that date that haven't been collected, earliest first.
- `POST /orders/{id}/collect`: marks an order as collected. Trying to collect it a second time is refused.

**Choices I made where you had no preference**
- Two customers can share a phone number.
- Measurements, price and deposit can't be negative or missing, and the deposit can't be more than the price. Measurements also have to be more than zero.
- The deposit is the only payment the app records, so it doesn't track the balance paid at pickup.
- An order can be marked collected even if it hasn't been fully paid.

There's no endpoint that lists all customers, so keep each customer's ID when you add them. You'll need it to add their orders, see them or update their measurements.
